_comment: Uniform DWM1001C hardware LOS noise floor (STABLE anchors A/C/D/F/G all converge to sigma1 ~ 23-29 mm). This is a CHIP property, not an environment property. Do NOT bake per-anchor environment-specific sigma here (e.g. the overnight B=161/E=190/H=67 are that-room/that-night, not device). All per-anchor / per-frame adaptation comes from the RF metric (FP-SNR) in effective_sigma at solve time.
